about.title: About
about.description: I'm a Senior Flutter developer with a strong product focus. Building commercial apps since 2018 (desktop → mobile since 2022). I take products from zero to release: architecture (Clean Architecture), state (BLoC), navigation (auto_route), integrations (Firebase/Maps/IAP/Push), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), analytics (Crashlytics/Analytics/AppsFlyer). Founder of Ovdix and VertoChat.
